batting.name: BMAJ Mendis
batting.dismissal: c I Sharma b DJG Sammy

batting.name: J Botha
batting.dismissal: c PA Patel b NLTC Perera

batting.name: PA Patel
batting.dismissal: st KM Jadhav b BMAJ Mendis

batting.name: A Ashish Reddy
batting.dismissal: c KM Jadhav b A Nehra

batting.name: KC Sangakkara
batting.dismissal: c UT Yadav b J Botha

balls.text: and Delhi have scored the lowest total of this tournament. Full, on off, Nehra drives, gets an inside edge onto the leg stump. The bail is off
breaks the maiden by dabbing at this shortish delivery outside off. Gets a couple to the right of third man
full and quick again, this time it stays low, and goes between the leg stump and the batsman
quick, 149ks, middle and leg, holds its line, through him, bounces over the leg stump
quick and straight again, on off, defended from the crease
good defensive shot to this outswinger in front of off
a slog to a length ball outisde off, drags this onto the off stump. Can't blame Pathan much
pushed wide of cover for one

one more gone. Pushed straight to midwicket. Nadeem wants one, Pathan doesn't. Then at some time Pathan thinks he should go. By that time Nadeem has turned his back on Pathan. However, Sanga's throw misses and gives them a lifeline. The backing up is good, though, and Nadeem sacrifices his wicket
length ball, swinging into middle and leg, beaten
length ball outside off, dabs on it, can't beat short third man
on a length, angling in, pushed into the leg side, between long-on and deep midwicket
slower ball, short of a length, bounces over his cut outside off
pushed to cover as this is pitched up outside off
short of a length, on the pads, pushed to midwicket for one

and Dire Delhi go down further. This is short of a length, outside off,  he swipes across the line, gets an almighty top edge that Parthiv Patel claims. Finally some reward for PP after taking the battering from balls staying low
short of a length, holds its line, hits the leading edge of the bat
down the track, nearly done in by the slower one. Takes a single with the ball left on the pitch
swipes across a wide length ball. Beaten by one that stays low. Parthiv is hit in the stomach
seam-up, quick, on the pads, worked away for one
full, flat legbreak, Botha is squared up, gets a single off the outside edge
short of a length, on off, defended back to him
googly, Botha has no idea about it, he gloves it onto his pad, but there is no short leg to catch it
tossed up outside off, left alone
stays back to defend a length-ball legbreak
short of a length, just outside off, defended to point

and how has that overthrow worked? Mendis is on strike thanks to that overthrow and he picks out a slower ball to drive it straight down Ishant's adam's-appled throat at long-on. Sammy pulls out the dummy again
pushed to extra cover for a single again. Sanga misses the stumps again. This time they will get an overthrow
slower ball, aborts the big drive, pushes this to extra cover to take a single
drives at a wide delivery with no foot movement. The ball stays low, and beats him
slower ball, short of a length, punched past point for one

Irfan might have run himself out. Bunted into the leg side for what looks like a single, but he takes Sammy on and goes back for the second. Looks out live time, but on replays he seems to have got a smidgeon over the line before the bail is dislodged
another googly, this time he plays it into the off side, but straight to cover
the googly again, stays low too, Pathan drags this from wide outside off into his pads
short of a length, cut away, can;t beat point
pauses in his delivery stride, bowls short, pushed into the leg side for one
worked into the leg side, wide enough of deep square leg to come back for two
driven back at him
lucky runs. Pathan wants to cut, but this is the non-turner, and the bottom edge avoids the stumps, and goes between Patel's legs. It might even have touched the off stump without dislodging the bail
this one doesn't turn, bunted into the leg side for one
quick legbreak, worked away off the pads for one
one more gone. Looked like an innocuous delivery, but the leading edge wasn't. Dips on him, on middle and leg, Jadhav looks to work him to leg. Gets a leading edge, and Sharma takes it gleefully
sweeps this full toss to long leg for one
slightly short, he goes back to pull it to deep midwicket
down the wicket to take this on the half-volley, drives it to deep midwicket for one
tossed up, middle and leg, defended off the inside half of the bat
full, on off, bunted into the leg side, with soft hands, takes a couple
Warner is clueless against spin. Why would you not send him up the order? Mishra bowls the googly again, Warner walks past it. Easy stumping for Parthiv Patel
short of a length, cramps him up with the legbreak. Hits the pad
short of a length, rising towards the chest, he fends at it, but it flies wide of the wide slip. Mishra misfields at third man to allow them the second

too good for Chand. What was he trying here? Bowled cross-seam but fast, short of a length, on off. Chand makes room to hit it square, but the ball has moved away a touch and taken the off stump even before the bat can come down
dug in short, rib-high, pulled away for a single to bring up the 50
short of a length, into the pads, worked away for one
length ball, on the pads, flicked away fine for four
short of a length, stays low, beats him. Patel has been hit hard on the hands as this bounces in front of him

there is the ugly side of the IPL fielding. Dropped. Don't go by the sensational catches only. The fielding has been ordinary too. Warner looks to slog, the ball doesn't turn, he skies it, but Vihari drops it. He was on the mic earlier. Actually, forget dropping it, Vihari hasn't even touched it. It has gone through his hands
on a length, on the pads, helped away for one
full, driven towards deep midwicket for one
swept away from outside off, gets a single to deep square
short again, pushed into the leg side for one
starts off with a short delivery, and gets away with it because it has been hit straight to extra cover
short of a length, middle and leg, pulled to long-on for one
shaping up for the big slog, but the ball dips on him, and doesn't turn either. So Warner has to abort the shot, and defends
short, turning back in, cut away to the right of deep point
down the wicket to drive this to sweeper-cover
this one doesn't turn. Might have been the googly. Yes this is the googly. Chand has not read this. Nearly bowled, but his bat comes down just in time
starts with a fullish legbreak, Chand goes back to cut, and is beaten
short of a length, angling in towards off, pushed to point
short of a length, outside off, runs this down to third man for one
punched away past cover for a single
driven on the up, with an open face, fielded at point by Karan Sharma
short of a length, angling in, defended off the back foot

and he is sucking on the dummy after the first ball he bowls. This is short of a length, just outside off, angles in, stays a touch low, Sehwag is cramped, and the off stump is gone. Sammy pulls the pacifier out. Princess Skai will have all these videos when she grows old
this is a bit too wide, Chand gets under it, and cuts it over point for four
Did Chand think this was a free hit? Because he charged down the wicket, shut his eyes, and swung. Doesn't touch it
short, widish, beaten by the extra bounce on the cut. He has hit the stump with his trailing calf. This is a no-ball but won't be followed by a free hit
this one cuts away from short of a length, and bounces in front of Patel again. No edge this time
short of a length, stays low again, takes the outside edge, but bounces in front of Patel
short of a length, just outside off, cut away to third man for one
dug in short, rising toowards his chest, on top of off, Sehwag looks to run this down, is beaten by the extra bounce
stays short of that driving length, and accurate, and all Chand can do is defend this back
flicked away off the pads for one
defended into the leg side, and Sehwag calls him through for a quick single

ugly swipe. The machine says there is no balance in his account. Short of a length, on off, he slogs across it. Had he been any farther from the ball, he would have needed a visa to be in the same country as the ball
on a length, middle and leg, defended to mid-on
short of a length, on off, dropped into the leg side for one
short, wide, beats him on the cut
short of a length, outside off, punched away to cover-point
132ks, on a length, outside off, and this one shoots through. Good job it was not straight
pushed with an open face to point

nearly gone on two counts. This short ball skids on him, and he is too late into the pull. The mis-hit, though, doesn't carry to mid-on. Mishra charges in and nearly runs him out, but misses with the throw
dug in short, pulled wide of mid-on for two
the rare loose ball. Short, wide, cut away in front of point for four
short of a length, jags back in, takes the inside edge onto his ribs. What was Jayawardene saying about this being a slow and low pitch?
bouncer first up, but too high

the great IPL umpiring continues. Jayawardene is given out when outside the line of off. This is good bowling, but not sure he is out. He has walked down and across the wicket, misses with the across-the-line drive. Given by Rauf. Jayawardene is not happy. I wouldn't blame him
short of a length, seams back in, cuts him in two. Hits him on the thigh pad. Sehwag is giggling at the other end. Surely because he is not on strike?
short of a length, outside off, defended off the back foot
whipped away off the pads for a single to long leg
short of a length, into the pads, bunted away to leg to get off the mark

huge shout. Steyn and Patel think this has come off the glove. This is a mean delivery. Dug in short, rising towards the chest, but slightly down leg. Sehwag is not watching it, fends at it, but is hit on the forearm, which is stinging now, I am sure
short of a length, outside off, stays low to beat his back-foot shot
straying onto the pads again, concedes the leg-bye only
pulls the length back a little. Defended in front of off
on a length, on the pads, Jayawardene plays a nice little pick-up over long leg for six
the first ball with some room on it, but Sehwag has pushed this straight to cover-point. Maiden. Two overs, four on the board, not a run earned
accurate again. Short of a length, on off, Sehwag stands tall and defends in front of off
slightly fuller, seaming in again, gets the inside edge onto the pad this time
again beats him with the seam movement. Beats the inside edge again, headed down leg again
Sammy is on his knees appealing from slip. This is short of a length, seaming in, beats the inside edge, but it is headed down. Sammy, though, is too excited for some reason
short of a length, on off, defended off the back foot
nearly the finishing move. Jayawardene had been set up superbly. Now he pushed at an outswinger just outside off, but the edge was soft, and went between the keeper and slip
short of a length, on off, shaping away a touch. Defended off the back foot
poor shot. Mahela charges at him, Steyn bowls another outswinger on leg, it swings and beats his bat. Passes over the leg stump
pushed with soft hands, with an open face, towards point
another outswinger. This one starts a little wider. Left alone
outswinger, 135ks, defended in front of off
driven through the covers to bring up the win. Wide length ball, and despatched with the drive
van der Merwe has saved a certain four with a dive to his right at backward point
bouncer, outside off, he stays away from it
wide down the leg side now

appeal for lbw but he seems to have got a huge inside edge onto the pads. It rolls away to the third man fence. Replays show his outside edge is beaten, and there is no inside edge on it. However, this is still too high to be giving an lbw
short of a length, pushed to point where van der Merwe - a substitute - makes a diving save
legbreak, flighted, on middle and leg, defended off the front foot
Sammy has smacked this clean. Short, stays low, but Sammy goes ahead with a forceful shot, and clears long-on with it
full, on off, driven back to him
flighted outside off, the googly this time, worked into the leg side
sharp legbreak. Everything right with this. Dip, on a length, on off, turns away sharply. Beats the edge
starts off with a googly, driven to deep cover for one
swept away wide of deep square

wide down the leg side. Kedar Jadhav has come charging down at the umpire Asnani for a catch at the wicket, but the umpire stretches his arms. This is a topspinner outside leg, and seems to have kissed the glove on the way. I see some deviation
makes room to cut this to deep cover for one
slightly short, pulled straight to short midwicket

beautiful shot, but he is gone. He seems to have lofted this wide of long-off, but not wide enough. Yadav stays on the rope and takes the catch. I am surprised this is taken, but that fielder was placed wide
stays back to a length ball, punched down to long-off
down the wicket, but finds short midwicket
on a length, middle and leg, worked away to leg for one. They get an overthrow from Botha's wild return
punched down to long-off for one
short of a length, outside off, cut to point
long hop down the leg side but he can't beat long leg with the pull
tossed up slow outside off, driven to cover
tossed up, gets slight dip on it, Sammy defends, is hit on the pad, but the ball is turning down leg
full, on off, driven to long-off for another single
driven to wide long-on for one
Sammy is looking to smack everything out of the ground, but this one skids and hits him on the thigh pad
into the pads, worked into the leg side for one
short of a length, outside off, defended to point
googly again, too short, punched away to deep cover
googly again, driven to extra cover
pushes forward at a full ball, gets a single off the outside edge
dropped by Warner. A really tough chance. This is short, a legbreak, Sammy goes for the big hit, the ball skids on, lobs towards long-on. Warner sprints in, but can't reach it
googly again, Sanga reads it, drives with the spin, takes a single to long-off
short, legbreak, cut away to deep cover
full, middle and leg, defended to midwicket
pushed to cover for a single. Sanga has to dive in
full, middle and leg, a dart really. Defended back
on a length, middle and leg, worked to leg
punched down to long-on for one
sharp turn for a shortish delivery. Sammy pulls out of the shot
flighted on middle and leg. Defended to leg

Patel should have known better. He has walked past a googly. Patel has not read it, played for the legbreak, overbalanced, and has been stumped. Kedar Jadhav fumbled with the take but recovered well enough
another googly. Too short, pulled away to deep midwicket. Clearly the net run rate is on Sunrisers' minds
flicked away to short fine leg for one
another googly, defended off the back foot. Mendis's regulation ball is the googly, and the legbreak is his variation
starts off with a googly, swept to square leg

Nehra is stunned the batsman is not moving. He has hit the leather off this shortish delivery. A bit of an offcutter. The extra bounce takes the edge. The batsman is not walking, the umpire has not raised his finger, and it makes Nehra turn around with a look of disbelief. Umpire Asnani then raises the finger. fair enough. No one had appealed until then
stays low outside off, the bottom edge goes between the keeper and the slip. Gets him a single
clears the front leg to swipe this to leg for a single
bouncer, down the leg side, called a wide
short of a length, middle and leg, defended
short of a length, just outside off, punched away despite there being no room. Gets four for it through cover
short of a length, stays low, but he has brought the bat down in time
defended off the front foot
short of a length, on off, punched back to him
Rauf strikes again. Short, middle and leg, skids on, beats the pull, but it seems headed down leg
hard hands, gets an edge on the drive, takes a single to cover-point
short of a length, into the pads, whipped away wide of deep midwicket for two
full, on off, dug out back to him
dismissive. Dhawan is showing them no respect. Stands tall and drives on the up, between cover and mid-off for four. All along the ground
driven on the up again. Showing no regard for the bowler. But finds cover with this
short of a length, on off, runs this down to third man
slower ball, driven to cover
short of a length, just outside off, punched away to third man
short of a length, on off, bunted to cover for one
bouncer, over his right shoulder. Dhawan has to sway out of its line

Dhawan is brimming with confidence. He jumps at Nehra, makes room, then drives this from outside leg, through cover-point for four. That is incredible. You wouldn't even try if you were not overconfident
looks to drive on the up, but this is a bit too short. Mis-hit back to Nehra
this one moves in from a length, hits the inside half of the bat, but they will get a single
short of a length, pushed wide of point for one
nicely driven off the back foot, but straight to cover-point
extra bounce. Short of a length, 144ks, on off, jumps away, and beats his defence
short of a length, outside off, left alone
short, wide, Patel packs a punch behind this cut, placing it between point and cover-point
this shortish delivery stays low, but he dabs it away for a single
back-foot drive, on the up, to a wide shortish ball, to the left of cover for four

Nadeem and Pathan struggling with communication again. Dhawan gets a top edge that falls between Pathan, who is running back from square leg, and Nadeem, who is running in from the fence. No on has called, and luckily they avoid the collision
short of a length, outside off, defended off the back foot
Dhawan still gives him the charge, is cramped up on the shot, mis-hits to mid-on for one
down the wicket again. Not quite to the pitch of the ball, pushes this on the up, and between the bowler and mid-on. Lovely timing on it
down the wicket to drive this shortish delivery to cover
on a length, on off, pushed with an open face to cover-point
edged first ball, but flies wide of slip. Pathan gets the customary swing first up, hits the shoulder of the bat
